dynamic_speed_profiles.selection_semantics: condition on the exact demand scale; select one calibration realization per low-fidelity episode; within that realization query the nearest-in-time SUMO lane speed for the same line and physical stop

backward_headway_observation.low_fidelity_proxy: a hash-locked set of zero-hold SUMO observation-speed traces from the five registered calibration realizations, conditioned by demand scale, line, physical stop, and event time
backward_headway_observation.route_coordinate_semantics: cumulative route length through each stop element in the frozen SUMO line decomposition; segment distances affect spatial observations but not the separately calibrated decision-clock runtime
backward_headway_observation.semantics: convert the observable distance to the scheduled following bus into seconds using the current stop lane speed, matching the SUMO bridge's traci.lane.getLastStepMeanSpeed quantity without substituting the signal-delayed whole-segment travel speed

data_partition.selection_rule: formal blocks 0-4 fit segment runtimes; blocks 5-9 are excluded from fitting and reserved for the simulator fidelity acceptance audit

decision_ready_time_semantics: ceil(exact service-completion time - 1e-9), matching the integer SUMO event clock
